title: Strain-Induced BCC-to-FCC Transformation in Tungsten Uncovered by Molecular Dynamics Simulations with Machine Learning Potentials
summary: DFT-informed machine-learning-potential molecular dynamics predicts a previously unreported strain-induced BCC→FCC pathway in tungsten, with a temperature/dislocation-dependent FCC fraction and structural pathway. This is a concrete computational materials result; experimental confirmation remains future work.
ai_technology: The authors use a neural-evolution-potential machine-learning interatomic potential, trained/checked against DFT structures, to run GPUMD molecular dynamics under tensile strain.
organization: Affiliation not stated in the reviewed material
